recognitionRules: Use slate-blue reading fields with restrained gold highlights.
Keep the display face for entry titles and clear sans-serif text for detail.
Give each entry a stable local label and route back to the index.
Separate observations, practical guidance and source references.

quote: Open an entry. Notice the detail. Carry one useful question outside.
rightsSummary: Original fictional identity and vector logos; portable font binaries retain their licenses. Source family dependencies and substitutions are documented.
logoDirection: Use OPEN FIELD ATLAS in the source display face with an open L-shaped corner and a small index dot. Avoid a compass rose.
invariants: Use slate-blue reading fields with restrained gold highlights.
Keep the display face for entry titles and clear sans-serif text for detail.
Give each entry a stable local label and route back to the index.
adaptations: Mobile entries stack their information in the same order.
Printable entries retain index labels and source notes.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.
decisionStatus: Template-derived editorial identity for the requested library. Creative rules are proposed production directions; no real organization or official endorsement is asserted.
